name: Kenya Conservancies Fund
summary: A small-grant facility run by KWCA for new and under-served Kenyan wildlife conservancies, funding biodiversity conservation, habitat restoration, governance and nature-based enterprises. Calls for concepts are announced on its website; the 2025 call has closed.
